# Avro

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from avro/lang.json and avro/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

This page helps you build, test and check Avro code with rules_dx.

## Quick start

`MODULE.bazel` sits at the root of your repository and lists the Bazel modules, meaning external dependencies, that your project uses. Add `rules_dx` to it:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

Then let dx set up the rest, as in the [Quickstart](../../README.md#quickstart):

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init --apply
```

For a Avro project, `MODULE.bazel` then looks like this:

```python
module(name = "my_project")

bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<release>")
```

A `BUILD.bazel` file declares targets: the libraries, binaries and tests that Bazel builds. This one is a small Avro package from [`avro/tests/consumer`](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/avro/tests/consumer/BUILD.bazel):

```python
load("@rules_dx//avro:defs.bzl", "avro_library")

avro_library(
    name = "my_project",
    srcs = ["point.avsc"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
)
```

Build and test everything. `//...` means every target in the repository:

```sh
tools/dx test //...
```

## Rules

`load` brings rules into a `BUILD.bazel` file. Load the ones you use from `@rules_dx//avro:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//avro:defs.bzl", "avro_library", "avro_cc_library", "avro_java_library")
```

### `avro_library`

Owns Apache Avro schemas for dx lint.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Avro schema files of this package. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | avro_library targets whose schemas these import. |

### `avro_cc_library`

One C++ header with every type of the avro_library deps and their imports, and the runtime.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | avro_library targets to generate C++ for. |
| `namespace` | `string` | no | C++ namespace passed to avrogencpp. |
| `_avro_union` | `label` | no |  |
| `_avrogencpp` | `label` | no |  |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |

### `avro_java_library`

Java classes for the schemas of avro_library deps and their imports, compiled once.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | avro_library targets to generate Java for. |
| `_avro_union` | `label` | no |  |
| `_avro_tools` | `label` | no |  |
| `_runtime` | `label` | no |  |
| `_zipper` | `label` | no |  |

## Tools and package files

dx runs these tools and reads these package files for Avro:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tools | `avro_tools`, `prettier` |
| Ecosystems | none |
| Manifests | none |
| Lockfiles | none |

## Platforms

Avro builds and tests on:

- Linux arm64
- Linux x86_64
- macOS arm64
- Windows arm64
- Windows x86_64

## API docs

`tools/dx docs` builds the API docs with `avro-tools`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

To declare a docs target yourself, load the rule behind it:

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/avro:defs.bzl", "avro_doc_shard")
```

### `avro_doc_shard`

```python
avro_doc_shard(name, avro, package = "", **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one avro_library.
